overview: Kaziranga's one-horned rhinos in Assam's grasslands, then Meghalaya's cool capital Shillong with lakes and waterfalls.
fit: Good for both; jeep safaris are fine for families and elephant safaris have age limits.
season: Kaziranga opens 1 November and closes around end-April. Nov–Feb is cool and dry. Shillong is pleasant from October to April.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Guwahati, then 5 hr to Kaziranga; Shillong 3 hr from Guwahati

todo.title: Elephant safari at dawn
todo.book: Age limits; ethics vary, so decide as a family

todo.title: Umiam Lake
todo.why: Boating on the way to Shillong

foodTips: Vegetarian food is available; tell restaurants in Shillong in advance.
save: Book jeep safaris through the resort or Kaziranga's official site
Combine with Shillong to make one long loop
safety: Hill roads to Shillong: experienced driver
kids: Rhinos are easy to spot, which keeps the kids excited
Don Bosco Museum is great for the 10-year-old

days.plan: Fly to Guwahati; drive to Kaziranga
Orchid Park; drive towards Shillong; Umiam Lake
